catena.traslitterazione: quarter of a larger valued coin

parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai บาท (bàat), from Pali pāda (quarter of a larger valued coin), ultimately from Sanskrit पाद (quarter).

parole.significato: A vessel, usually made of glass or ceramic and filled with water, used in smoking various substances, especially cannab…
parole.testo: From Thai บ้อง (bɔ̂ng, “a marijuana pipe”). First use in English appears c. 1971 in the publication Marijuana Review.

parole.significato: climbing wattle

parole.significato: Any of the provinces of Thailand.

parole.significato: check, bill (at a restaurant)

parole.significato: A Thai Buddhist monument similar to a stupa.

parole.significato: A pair of small bowl-shaped finger cymbals made of thick and heavy bronze, used in the music of Thailand and Cambodia.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ฉิ่ง (chìng).

parole.significato: A spicy Thai dish made with wide, flat rice noodles, meat, vegetables, and basil.

parole.significato: A kind of Asian horoscope.

parole.significato: A foreigner in Thailand who is of Western ancestry; one who comes to Thailand from a Western country.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ฝรั่ง (fà-ràng, “Westerner”). Doublet of Frank, frank, franc, and firangi.

parole.significato: An old coin of Thailand.
parole.testo: From Thai เฟื้อง (fʉ́ʉang).

parole.significato: Synonym of jasmine rice.
parole.termine_origine: ข้าวหอมมะลิ

parole.testo: From Thai ข้าวหอมมะลิ (kâao-hɔ̌ɔm-má-lí).

parole.significato: The ethnic Lao people who have traditionally lived in Isan.
parole.testo: From Thai อีสาน (ii-sǎan) (same in Isan), claimed to be from Sanskrit ईशान (īśāna, “Shiva of the northeast”).

parole.significato: Synonym of jungle curry
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai แกงป่า (gɛɛng-bpàa)

parole.significato: A sour Thai seafood curry made with tamarind.

parole.significato: A feminine or effeminate transgender person or person of a third gender assigned male at birth from Cambodia, Laos, or…

parole.significato: A cat of a rare breed originating in Thailand, pure white with a short, smooth, close-lying coat.
parole.testo: From Thai ขาว (kǎao, “white”) + มณี (má-nii, “gem”).

parole.significato: Synonym of Khao Manee.
parole.testo: From Thai ขาว (kǎao) + ปลอด (bplɔ̀ɔt), literally “completely white”.

parole.significato: Wide rice noodles.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ข้าวซอย (kâao-sɔɔi), which is perhaps derived from Burmese ခေါက်ဆွဲ (hkaukhcwai:) or Shan ၶဝ်ႈသွႆး (khāo sáui).

parole.significato: a stringed musical instrument from South East Asia, played with bamboo sticks.
parole.testo: From Thai ขิม (kǐm).

parole.significato: A canal on the central plain of Thailand.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai คลอง (klɔɔng, “canal, watercourse”).

parole.significato: A Thai form of dance with music and narration.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai โขน (kǒon).

parole.significato: A spicy southern Thai dish made with meat and curry paste.
parole.testo: From Thai คั่วกลิ้ง (kûua-glîng).

parole.significato: A blue-grey short-haired breed of domestic cat with heart-shaped head and large green eyes.

parole.significato: A tree, Mitragyna speciosa, endemic to Southeast Asia.

parole.significato: a Thai television drama
parole.testo: From Thai ละคร (lá-kɔɔn).

parole.significato: Of or relating to the Lanna region, language or culture.

parole.significato: A Thai whisky made from fermented rice.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai เหล้าขาว (literally “white liquor”).

parole.significato: A genre of Thai popular music in a rural style.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ลูกทุ่ง (lûuk-tûng, literally “rural”).

parole.significato: A devout Buddhist laywoman in Thailand.
parole.testo: From Thai แม่ชี.

parole.significato: A Thai game somewhat similar to chess.
parole.testo: From Thai หมากรุก (màak-rúk).

parole.significato: A type of Southeast Asian lime with small, fragrant fruits, and the leaves of which are used in cooking for their citru…
parole.testo: From Thai มะกรูด (má-grùut) + English lime.

parole.significato: A Thai curry of Muslim origin (or the paste used to make it), usually containing coconut milk, roasted peanuts, potatoe…
parole.testo: From Thai มัสมั่น (mát-sà-màn, “Muslim-like curry”), from Persian مسلمان (mosalmân, “Muslim”), from Arabic مُسْلِم (muslim, “Muslim”).

parole.significato: A type of crispy rice noodles from Thailand, normally served with a sweet sauce.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai หมี่กรอบ (mìi-grɔ̀ɔp, literally “crisp noodles”).

parole.significato: principal wife or chief wife
parole.testo: From Thai เมียหลวง (miia-lǔuang).

parole.significato: minor wife; secondary wife; wife of inferior rank; concubine, mistress
parole.testo: From Thai เมียน้อย (miia-nɔ́ɔi).

parole.significato: An ethnic group of Thailand and Laos, traditionally nomadic hunter-gatherers.

parole.significato: An administrative subdivision of Thailand at the beginning of the 20th century, each led by a royal commissioner.

parole.significato: The sport of Muay Thai.
parole.testo: From Thai มวย (muay, “boxing”).

parole.significato: A sport practiced in Thailand which is similar to boxing but also allows strikes with the shins, feet, elbows, and knee…
parole.testo: From Thai มวยไทย (muai-tai, “Thai boxing”).

parole.significato: The lowest level of administrative subdivision in Thailand, comparable to a village, part of a tambon
parole.testo: From Thai หมู่บ้าน (mùu-bâan).

parole.significato: Any of numerous dipping sauces in Thai cuisine.

parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ผัดขี้เมา (pàt-kîi-mao).

parole.significato: A stir fry Thai dish made from wide rice noodles, egg, broccoli, a protein, and a sweet soy sauce.
parole.testo: From Thai ผัดซีอิ๊ว (pàt-sii-íu, “soy sauce stir-fry”).

parole.significato: A Thai dish of stir-fried noodles with egg, tamarind, peanuts and other ingredients.
parole.testo: From Thai ผัดไทย (pàt-tai, “Thai stir-fry”).

parole.significato: A stir-fired Thai dish made with glass noodles, tofu or meat, egg, cabbage, and carrot.
parole.termine_origine: ผัดวุ้นเส้น

catena.termine: ผัดวุ้นเส้น

parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ผัดวุ้นเส้น, a compound of ผัด (pàt, “stir fry”) and วุ้นเส้น (wún-sên, “glass noodles”).

parole.significato: A thick red Thai curry made with peanuts and spices.
parole.testo: From Thai พะแนง (pá-nɛɛng).

parole.significato: A traditional Thai garment, a long strip of cloth wrapped around the waist, reaching below the knees, and sometimes pas…
parole.testo: From Thai ผ้านุ่ง (pâa-nûng).

parole.significato: An ornamental tray with a pedestal, common in Thailand, Cambodia, and Laos.

parole.significato: An ensemble of wind and percussion instruments in central Thai classical music.
parole.testo: From Thai ปี่พาทย์ (bpìi-pâat).

parole.significato: A traditional Thai seasoning made by fermenting fish with rice bran or roasted rice powder and salt for a long period.

parole.significato: Synonym of Siamese fighting fish.

parole.significato: A unit of area used in Thailand that is equal, in modern times, to 1,600 square metres (16 ares, 0.16 hectares, 0.3954…

parole.significato: A serving of Red Bull.
parole.testo: Calque of Thai กระทิงแดง (krathing daeng, literally “red gaur”), the drink that inspired Red Bull.

parole.significato: An open pavilion in Thailand used as a meeting place or to shelter from the weather.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ศาลา (sǎa-laa), ultimately from Sanskrit शाला (śālā, “hall”).

parole.significato: A pedicab in Thailand or Laos.

parole.significato: A subdivision of currency, equal to one hundredth of a Thai baht.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai สตางค์ (sà-dtaang).

parole.testo: Thai ซอสามสาย (sɔɔ-sǎam-sǎai)

parole.significato: A unit of length equal 20 wa, 40 meters.

parole.significato: bride price

parole.significato: In Thailand, a side-street branching off a major street; an alley or lane.
parole.testo: From Thai ซอย (sɔɔi).

parole.significato: green papaya salad, a Thai dish of sliced sour fruits and vegetables, as green papayas, tomatoes, etc., and other ingre…
parole.testo: From Thai ส้มตำ (sôm-dtam).

parole.significato: Senegalia rugata (syn. Acacia concinna), a species of acacia which holds importance in several Southeast Asian traditio…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ส้มป่อย (sôm-bpɔ̀i), from Thai ส้ม (sôm, “orange, sour”) + Thai ปอย (bpɔɔi, “tuft”), referring to the flowers of the plant.

parole.significato: A boiled egg that has been shelled and then deep-fried.
parole.testo: Calque of Thai ไข่ลูกเขย (khai luuk kheeuy), from ไข่ (khai, “egg”) + ลูกเขย (luuk kheeuy, “son-in-law”).

parole.significato: A pickup truck converted into a shared taxi by the addition of a bench or row of seats along each side of the bed.
parole.testo: From Thai สองแถว (sɔ̌ɔng-tɛ̌o), from สอง (sɔ̌ɔng, “two”) + แถว (tɛ̌o, “row”).

parole.significato: A Thai-style hot sauce, typically made from sun-ripened chili peppers, vinegar, garlic, sugar and salt.
parole.testo: From Thai ศรีราชา (sǐi-raa-chaa), named after the city of Si Racha in Thailand.

parole.significato: A shorthaired breed of cat originating in Thailand, having solid reddish-brown fur.

parole.significato: Synonym of iridescent shark (“a shark catfish of species Pangasianodon hypophthalmus”).

parole.significato: An administrative subunit in Thailand below district (amphoe) and province (changwat).

parole.significato: An old coin of Thailand.

parole.significato: A type of double-headed barrel drum used in Thailand.

parole.significato: Of or pertaining to Thailand.

parole.significato: A fermented soybean product of Burmese and Thai cuisine.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ถั่วเน่า (tùua-nâo)

parole.significato: A Thai soup or soup base: a spicy curry in coconut milk with galangal, usually made with chicken.

parole.significato: A Thai soup or curry of chicken, coconut milk, galangal, and other spices.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ต้มข่าไก่, from ต้มข่า (dtôm-kàa) (see tom kha) + ไก่ (gài, “chicken”).

parole.significato: A Thai soup flavoured with fish sauce, lemongrass, lime juice, and chillies.

parole.significato: A motorized rickshaw, especially Southeast Asia or India.
parole.testo: From Thai ตุ๊ก ๆ (dtúk-dtúk), onomatopoeic for the sound of its two-stroke engine.

parole.significato: A spiritual symbol in Buddhism.

parole.significato: A Thai unit of length, traditionally comparable to a fathom, and now officially equal to two metres.
parole.testo: From Thai วา (waa).

parole.significato: A Thai greeting wherein the palms are brought together in front of the face or chest, sometimes accompanied with a bow.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai ไหว้ (wâi, “a gesture of thanks”).

parole.significato: A Buddhist temple in Southeast Asia, especially those in Thailand, Laos, and Cambodia.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Thai วัด (wát).

parole.significato: A tablet containing a mix of methamphetamine and caffeine, popular among drug users in Thailand.
parole.testo: From Thai ยาบ้า (yaa-bâa, “madness drug”).
